records.jp: ここが愛央ちゃんのココロトープ……
なんていうか、拍子抜けするくらい平和だね
私のココロトープ……
（何の特徴もない。これは……<CR>私が過ごした街の景色だ）
records.en_original: (There's nothing special about it... It's just the town I lived in.)
records.en_auxiliary: (There's nothing special about it... It's just the town I lived in.)
records.en: (There is nothing distinctive about it. This is...<CR>the town where I lived.)

records.jp: （普通で、どこにでもある、ただの街並み――）
records.en_original: (A regular-old town that you'd find anywhere...)
records.en_auxiliary: (A regular-old town that you'd find anywhere...)
records.en: (A regular-old town that you'd find anywhere...)

records.jp: わっ！？　びっくりした……
愛央、スマホが鳴ってる
な、なんだろう……？<CR>このタイミングで鳴るなんて……
records.en_original: I-I wonder why it would start ringing now...?
records.en_auxiliary: I-I wonder why it would start ringing now...?
records.en: W-why would it start ringing<CR>at this exact moment...?

records.jp: 愛央、なんて書いてあった？
それが、何も書いてなくて……
records.en_original: That's just it. It didn't say anything...
records.en_auxiliary: That's just it. It didn't say anything...
records.en: That's just it. It didn't say anything...

records.jp: 通知だけ鳴ったってことですか……？
records.en_original: Then you got an alert, but not a message?
records.en_auxiliary: Then you got an alert, but not a message?
records.en: Then you got an alert, but not a message?

records.jp: ってことは……何かの間違いだったのかな？
records.en_original: Maybe it was a wrong number?
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it was a wrong number?
records.en: Then...maybe it was some kind of mistake?

records.jp: え、今度は何――？
何これ、眩し――――
い、一体何が……
あ、あれ……？　何も起きてない……？
いや……あれを見て
あれ、何……？
なんか出てきた……！？
何あの、歯車の固まりみたいなやつ……
records.en_original: The heck is that? It looks like a big hunk of a gears...
records.en_auxiliary: The heck is that? It looks like a big hunk of a gears...
records.en: What is that thing...? It looks like a huge mass of gears...

records.jp: さ、さっきまであんなのなかったよね……？
records.en_original: Th-that definitely wasn't there before, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that definitely wasn't there before, right?
records.en: Th-that definitely wasn't there before, right?

records.jp: えっ？　突然出てきたってこと……？
records.en_original: Huh? You mean it just suddenly appeared...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You mean it just suddenly appeared...?
records.en: Huh? You mean it just suddenly appeared...?

records.jp: 愛央、これは、どういう……？
records.en_original: Ao, what's the meaning of this...?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, what's the meaning of this...?
records.en: Ao, what's the meaning of this...?

records.jp: わ、分かんないよ！<CR>あんなの、私も知らない……
records.en_original: I-I have no idea! I've never seen anything like this...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I have no idea! I've never seen anything like this...
records.en: I-I don't know!<CR>I've never seen anything like that either...

records.jp: 本人が見たことない物体が、<CR>なんでココロトープに……？
records.en_original: Why would something someone's never seen appear in their Heartscape...?
records.en_auxiliary: Why would something someone's never seen appear in their Heartscape...?
records.en: Why would something the person herself has never seen<CR>appear in her Heartscape...?

records.jp: こ、これって、どういうことですか……？
あ、歩き回れば何か分かるんじゃないかな……？
records.en_original: M-maybe if we walk around we'll find some clues...?
records.en_auxiliary: M-maybe if we walk around we'll find some clues...?
records.en: M-maybe if we walk around we'll find some clues...?

records.jp: そう、だよね……
（どうなってるんだろう、私の心の中……）
